description: Look up a threat indicator in OTX: an IPv4 or IPv6 address, a domain or hostname, a URL, an MD5/SHA1/SHA256 file hash, or a CVE id such as CVE-2021-4034. Returns the threat-intel pulses referencing that indicator plus observed-context fields, so it answers questions like which campaigns exploit a given CVE or whether an IP is known-malicious. type is auto-detected when omitted.

indicator.description: The value to look up: IPv4, IPv6, domain, hostname, URL, MD5/SHA1/SHA256 hash, or a CVE id such as CVE-2021-4034. Auto-detected — you do not need to pass `type`.

type.description: Force a type instead of auto-detecting. Case-insensitive and forgiving — "ip"/"ipv4"/"ip_address" all mean IPv4, "CVE" means cve, "md5"/"sha256"/"hash" all mean file. Leave it off unless auto-detection gets it wrong.

name: lookup_indicator
